name: Shareout
tagline: Publish HTML deliverables, collect feedback, and revise at the same link.
description: Publish HTML reports, software proposals, presentations and interactive walkthroughs with Shareout. The skill guides file upload, audience and expiry choices, stable-link revisions, and review feedback. Requires a Shareout account plus the standalone CLI or a separately configured MCP connection. The skill never passes document bytes through tool arguments. The integration files are MIT licensed; the hosted service has separate terms.

install.notes: Connect the CLI or hosted MCP before publishing. Setup: https://shareout.io/agents. Hosted MCP: https://shareout.io/mcp. Signup requires email; MCP authentication uses OAuth. Installation and file-transfer guidance is in the repository README.
